items.title: 67520_George Handy oral history interview
items.q: Harry Biss who had been playing with them blew his top one night and put his fist through a glass door and cut his arm up so he couldn't play

ctx.x: I told him that I could find him work if he came out there with me.

He rejoined them in San Francisco and a few weeks later they called me--Harry Biss who had been playing with them blew his top one night and put his fist through a glass door and cut his arm up so he couldn't play, and that's when it happened. I went back and rejoined the

band and he wanted a chart on "There's No You" and I sat down and I can't tell you what happened but there was a click in my life, something clicked, all the fences went down and I could see, my horizon was limitless, I could write anything I wanted anytime.
